title: 洪水預報與水庫聯合操作
titleEn: Flood forecasting and coordinated reservoir operation
summary: 以「洪水預報與水庫聯合操作」為研究主題，規劃拆解水理條件、結構介面、施工順序與運轉驗證。目前為選題路線圖，逐步課程與專案細節尚待編審；所附通用來源屬類別背景。
summaryEn: Study topic: Flood forecasting and coordinated reservoir operation. Planned coverage includes hydraulic conditions, structural interfaces, construction sequence and operational verification. Roadmap entry: step-by-step lessons and project details await editorial review; general references provide category context.
